title: Design System: PC仲裁员端办案系统

display.purpose: Card titles, page titles, active menu items. The largest text in the system.

body.purpose: All content text, table cells, form labels, button labels. The workhorse.

caption.purpose: Count annotations, helper text, filter button labels, pagination.

micro.purpose: Tiny tags like suspended status. Never used for actionable text.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Dashboard cards on hover. Brand-tinted, low-opacity.

shadows.name: stat-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Statistics board cards on hover. Slightly tighter than dashboard cards.

shadows.name: floating-ball
shadows.purpose: Chat floating action button. Higher elevation for overlay.

shadows.name: floating-ball-ai
shadows.purpose: AI assistant floating ball. Uses AI purple tint.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color changes).

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: Entrance animations and pop effects (login page only).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Fast transitions: color, background, border-color changes.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Base transitions: card hover box-shadow, sidebar collapse.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Slow transitions: background slides, step indicator fills.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for submit, save, confirm. Deep blue background with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #053d99; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a6bb5; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #04307a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #053d99; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Compact 12px button for filter actions (query/reset). Lives inside .filter-actions container.
components.css: .ds-btn-filter { background: #053d99; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-filter:hover { background: #3a6bb5; } .ds-btn-filter:active { background: #04307a; }

components.name: Ghost / Back Button
components.description: Secondary action button with transparent background and light border. Used for back/cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #606266; border: 1px solid #e4e7ed; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f7f7f7; border-color: #dcdfe6; }

narrative.overview:
This is a tool-grade enterprise UI for arbitration case management. Design serves function: every pixel earns its place by reducing friction in the arbitrator's daily workflow. The system is dense, structured, and restrained. It borrows the visual gravity of judicial authority (deep blue, precise hierarchy, no decorative noise) without mimicking paper or courtroom aesthetics.

The product runs on Element Plus 2.x with a deep blue brand override (#053d99). One font family, four font sizes, one accent color. The discipline is the design. When in doubt, the system errs toward more whitespace and fewer visual elements, not more.

The login page (LoginView.vue) is a documented exception: it uses an independent slate-blue palette and bespoke component styles that do not follow the main system tokens. This is intentional, as the login is a standalone marketing-adjacent surface. All post-login surfaces must follow the main system.
keyCharacteristics: Tool-grade density: information per viewport over decoration
Single accent color (#053d99) used sparingly for selection, links, and primary actions
Four-step type scale (16/14/12/10px), no intermediate values
Flat-by-default surfaces; shadows appear only on hover or state change
Selection indicator: 3px primary-color bar, reserved exclusively for active/selected states
prefers-reduced-motion honored across all interactive components

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: #053d99 is the only brand color used for selection, emphasis, and primary actions. Warning/danger/success colors are status-only. AI Purple is component-scoped. No screen should introduce a fifth hue family.

rules.name: The Four-Step Rule
rules.body: Only 16px, 14px, 12px, and 10px are permitted. 13px and 15px are forbidden; they break the rhythm without adding a meaningful step.

rules.name: The 768 Rule
rules.body: All modules use max-width: 768px as the mobile breakpoint. Do not use 767px or max-width: 769px; these create off-by-one gaps at the boundary.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, drag, floating). A resting card with a shadow is a design error.

rules.name: The Selection-Only Rule
rules.body: The 3px bar is exclusively a selection indicator. It must never appear on unselected/resting cards as decoration. A resting card with a 3px colored bar is a design error.

dos: Do use the four-step type scale (16/14/12/10px) exclusively. Adjacent steps must differ by at least 2px and 100 weight.
Do use 4-multiple spacing (4/8/12/16/20/24) for all padding, margin, and gap values.
Do use the global classes (.filter-bar, .table-section, .pagination-bar, .section-card, .todos-sidebar) defined in src/styles/element/index.scss. New modules must reuse, not redefine.
Do use var(--el-color-primary) and its ramp for all accent/selection/link states.
Do keep the 3px vertical bar exclusively for selection/active states. It is a selection indicator, not decoration.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: disable all transitions and animations when the media query matches.
Do use el-link type="primary" :underline="false" for all in-content links.
Do use el-table with v-loading for loading states and #empty slot for no-data states.
donts: Don't use 13px or 15px font sizes. They break the four-step rhythm.
Don't introduce a second font family. Hierarchy comes from size + weight, not typeface.
Don't add vertical borders to table cells. Only row bottom separators are permitted.
Don't remove the border-bottom: none !important on table headers, or add a bottom border to headers.
Don't redefine global class styles (.filter-bar, .table-section, etc.) inside component <style scoped> blocks.
Don't use the em dash in UI copy. Use commas, colons, periods, or parentheses instead.
Don't put a 3px colored bar on resting/unselected cards. The bar means selected or active, nothing else.
Don't use border-left color bars for timelines. Use full-border cards with rounded corners instead.
Don't use max-width: 767px as a breakpoint. Use max-width: 768px consistently across all modules.
Don't use shadows on resting surfaces. Shadows are reserved for hover, drag, and floating overlay states.
Don't introduce a fifth hue family. The system has four: brand blue, warning amber, danger red, success green (plus AI purple scoped to AI components only).
